accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Up to two accounts for Claude and for Codex · ChatGPT. If the active account runs out of its limit and both have a paid plan, Stella asks whether to switch to the other one and continue the current conversation. The second account stays active until you switch back. Plugins, skills, settings and MCP servers are shared between both accounts.
accounts.warning: ⚠ Warning: switching accounts to get around usage limits may violate the Anthropic and OpenAI terms of use. This can lead to a ban, possibly of all linked accounts. Use this feature at your own risk.
